baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ joins inward appetite to a first-person act of adding.
baseline_models.mechanism: The desired object is not named as a fixed possession; it is the speaker's further act of increase. Appetite therefore points toward continuation of a scalar process, making 'more' structurally open-ended.

activation_trace.role: Heartfelt desire and hope supplies the inward appetite that governs the requested addition.
Increase and growth supplies the unbounded scalar process toward which the appetite reaches.

changed_reading.before: He hopes to receive one more benefit.
changed_reading.after: He desires continuation of the adding process itself, so the appetite has no internally stated stopping point.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence marker ثُمَّ precedes يَطْمَعُ, while the complement makes the speaker's prospective increase the content of expectation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The enticement branch of ط م ع allows the prospect of further addition to generate expectation without constituting a promise. Focus-only evidence leaves the inducing prior event unidentified, but it distinguishes elicited expectation from a warranted claim.

activation_trace.role: Enticement and causing another to desire supplies an expectation-producing force that need not grant what it invites.
Increase and growth supplies the prospective benefit around which the induced expectation forms.

changed_reading.before: His hope independently precedes a possible gift.
changed_reading.after: The prospect of the speaker adding more may itself have trained the hope, while still giving him no entitlement to fulfillment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split mapping for أَزِيدَ includes ز و د, whose branch treats added stock as provision carried through transition.
baseline_models.mechanism: On the packet's non-dominant mapped root, the requested increase is not static enlargement but provisioning for onward movement. The focus supplies no destination, so this remains a directional possibility rather than a lexical replacement.

activation_trace.role: Heartfelt desire supplies the recipient's wish to be equipped for what comes next.
Carrying provision for a journey turns increase into portable supply for transition rather than mere accumulation.

changed_reading.before: He wants his present stock made larger.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, he wants the speaker to keep provisioning his onward passage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding first-person acts make, continuously extend, and prepare conditions for him. They supply the previously unidentified input to the enticement branch of ط م ع: benefaction becomes a feedback loop in which an established stream of support generates expectation of its own continuation.

activation_trace.role: Causing desire and raising expectation supplies the feedback effect produced by prior provision.
Increase and growth makes the desired outcome continuation of an already expanding stream.
Making something assume a state supplies deliberate benefaction as the first input to the expectation loop.
A connected addition that sustains another supplies the pattern of ongoing extension that invites another ask.
Preparation and leveling supplies a fully eased setting from which further expectation emerges.

structural_cues: First-person perfects in 74:12 and 74:14 lead through ثُمَّ to the present desire in 74:15.
The repeated beneficiary phrase لَهُ makes prior provision recipient-specific before the request for more.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: deliberate making, connected extension, and thorough preparation precede the desire. Reader arrow: repeated provision trains expectation of continued provision. Alternative: the sequence may expose preexisting greed without claiming that the gifts caused it.

changed_reading.before: He happens to want another increase after receiving benefits.
changed_reading.after: The earlier stream of tailored benefits has become expectation-producing, so he treats past generosity as a forecast of endless continuation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate refusal is explained by resistance to manifest signs. This revises open-ended hope into entitlement: he expects the giver's expansion while bending away from the very signs that would orient reception of the gift.

activation_trace.role: Heartfelt appetite supplies the live expectation that the next ayah evaluates.
Increase and growth supplies the benefit expected despite the recipient's resistance.
A manifest sign supplies the disclosed guidance against which the recipient's posture is measured.
Deviation from straightness and resistance to truth supplies the blocking posture that makes the expectation culpable.

structural_cues: كَلَّا immediately cancels the expected continuation.
إِنَّهُ in 74:16 gives the resistant posture as an explanation rather than an unrelated scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: refusal follows the desire and is coupled to resistance against signs. Reader arrow: that resistance converts hope into presumptuous entitlement. Alternative: the refusal could reject only the requested outcome without characterizing desire itself.

changed_reading.before: The desire is morally neutral and merely awaits an answer.
changed_reading.after: The desire claims continued increase while resisting the giver's signs, and the immediate refusal exposes that claim as entitlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The requested upward scalar movement is not simply stopped; it is answered by another upward movement whose valence is reversed. The speaker who was expected to add now imposes an exhausting ascent, preserving direction while replacing benefit with burden.

activation_trace.role: Hopeful appetite supplies the expected beneficial upward movement that will be reversed.
Increase and growth supplies the upward scalar direction retained by the punishment image.
A burdensome imposed task supplies the reversal from desired gift to compelled exertion.
Increase and upward rise preserves the direction of 'more' while turning it into ascent.
A grueling obstacle supplies the punitive cost attached to the retained upward direction.

structural_cues: The first-person future سَأُرْهِقُهُ answers the first-person أَزِيدَ after one intervening refusal.
The desired scalar 'more' and صَعُودًا share an upward direction but opposite beneficiary effects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: desired increase is followed by imposed burden and an ascent branch that explicitly includes increase upward. Reader arrow: the latter is a directional, valence-reversing answer to the former. Alternative: صَعُودًا may denote punishment independently, with no deliberate echo of increase.

changed_reading.before: The speaker simply withholds the hoped-for increase.
changed_reading.after: The speaker grants an inverted 'increase': more upwardness arrives as a burdensome climb rather than added benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory's overdoing branch becomes legible through a sequence of calculating measure followed by self-magnification. Desire for added quantity expands into a disposition that exceeds proper measure and culminates in performed greatness.

activation_trace.role: Exclamation at abundant desire supplies appetite already marked as excessive rather than merely present.
Overstepping measure through affectation supplies the bridge from wanting more to making oneself greater.
The measure at which a thing reaches its limit supplies the boundary that the appetite presses beyond.
Greatness and pride supplies the eventual self-enlargement produced by the excessive scalar drive.

structural_cues: The repeated قَدَّرَ sequence calculates and recalculates before وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ.
Successive ثُمَّ clauses make the later self-magnification part of the same unfolding disposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: excessive desire, overdoing, measured limits, and pride all occur in the trace. Reader arrow: the appetite for quantitative addition becomes qualitative self-enlargement. Alternative: the later planning and arrogance may describe a separate argumentative act rather than the inner form of 74:15's desire.

changed_reading.before: He seeks a larger external allotment.
changed_reading.after: The request for more reveals a scalar habit that also enlarges the self beyond measure into pride.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same increase root later names believers' growth in faith alongside certainty. The focus seeks a first-person addition delivered to the desirer; the later construction makes believing subjects themselves increase through their response to a testing sign. Increase is relocated from passive acquisition to epistemic and moral growth.

activation_trace.role: Appetite directed toward an external grant supplies the receiving posture contrasted with responsive growth.
Increase and growth supplies the shared scalar core whose domain and agency later change.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed supplies the epistemic environment of the later increase.
The repeated increase-and-growth branch supplies a direct same-root relocation from receiving more to growing in faith.
Heart-settling affirmation supplies faith as the content and quality of the later growth.

structural_cues: أَزِيدَ has the first-person speaker as the adding agent, whereas يَزْدَادَ makes the believers the increasing subject.
إِيمَانًا explicitly specifies the domain of the later increase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the same root recurs with believers as subject, faith as specification, and certainty nearby. Reader arrow: this recurrence evaluates the focus request by contrasting passive receipt with responsive growth. Alternative: both clauses may use a neutral increase lexeme without an intended evaluative contrast.

changed_reading.before: Increase means an unspecified quantity transferred to him.
changed_reading.after: The surah relocates meaningful increase into the subject's growth in faith, exposing his requested addition as the wrong domain and posture of 'more.'

context_deltas.mechanism: The market-bidding branch of increase meets acquisition and pledge imagery. On this reading, each desired addition is also a ledger entry: what is acquired does not merely enlarge the holder but helps constitute the claim by which the self is held.

activation_trace.role: Appetite for benefit supplies the acquisitive pressure behind the ledger analogy.
Seeking and bidding for more supplies the transactional escalation that turns addition into an accumulating account.
Seeking and acquiring livelihood or benefit supplies the gains entered into the account.
A security held against a claim supplies the reversal by which the acquiring self becomes bound collateral.

structural_cues: بِمَا ties the state of being pledged to what each self has acquired.
The universal كُلُّ نَفْسٍ broadens the consequence beyond the individual scene of 74:15.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: bidding for more, acquisition of benefit, and a held pledge are branch-backed. Reader arrow: additions function like account entries that increase liability as well as assets. Alternative: رَهِينَةٌ can express moral detention without any transactional echo back to the request for increase.

changed_reading.before: Each new addition can only improve his position.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, every sought gain also thickens the account that binds the acquiring self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later confession pairs failure to feed with the socially abased poor person. Read against the appetite for incoming increase, it exposes a one-way economy: addition is welcomed as inflow but does not become sustaining outflow toward need.

activation_trace.role: Appetite for a desired benefit supplies the open intake side of the social mechanism.
Increase and growth supplies the incoming surplus whose circulation is tested.
Feeding another supplies the missing outward transfer by which received increase could sustain someone else.
The abasement of poverty supplies the unmet recipient need against which accumulation is judged.

structural_cues: The earlier first-person possibility 'that I add' contrasts with the later plural admission 'we did not feed.'
The later confession generalizes the intake-without-outflow pattern beyond the single desirer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a desire for incoming increase and a later failure to feed the poor are explicit. Reader arrow: retained surplus should circulate, so blocked feeding diagnoses one-way accumulation. Alternative: the later plural speakers need not include the individual of 74:15 and may state an independent failure.

changed_reading.before: The request concerns only how much the recipient possesses.
changed_reading.after: The request participates in an asymmetrical economy that seeks added inflow while refusing sustaining outflow to the poor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later wish for individually delivered, opened written sheets repeats the focus's desire-plus-أَنْ-plus-grant pattern. It shows the appetite for more migrating from unspecified increase into a demand that disclosure itself be personalized and delivered on the demander’s terms.

activation_trace.role: Desire and appetite supplies the wanting posture repeated by the later demand.
Seeking and bidding for more supplies escalation from an unspecified addition to customized proof.
Seeking something out supplies the renewed volitional demand parallel to يَطْمَعُ.
Giving and delivery supplies the demanded transfer parallel to the speaker's prospective addition.
Written sheets supply the personalized object into which the appetite for more has migrated.
A published or unfolded writing supplies disclosure already opened for each demander.

structural_cues: يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ and يُرِيدُ ... أَنْ يُؤْتَى share a desire followed by an أَنْ-clause of receipt.
كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ individualizes the later demand, while صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً specifies its customized object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a parallel wanting-and-delivery construction later demands individual opened sheets. Reader arrow: both are expressions of recipient-controlled escalation, extending appetite from goods to bespoke revelation. Alternative: 74:52 may criticize a distinct epistemic demand without interpreting the material scope of 74:15.

changed_reading.before: He wants only another material increment.
changed_reading.after: His 'more' is a portable demand-structure that can seek even revelation as a customized delivery owed to each recipient.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus lets human appetite project a future first-person act for the giver; the closing sequence places even human remembering inside divine will. This reverses control: wanting can name a hoped-for act, but cannot script the giver's volition.

activation_trace.role: Hopeful appetite supplies the human projection of what the speaker should do next.
The speaker's prospective increase supplies the divine action that appetite attempts to anticipate.
Bringing something to mind supplies the human act whose possibility is explicitly bounded.
Will directed toward an act supplies divine volition as the governing condition rather than an object of human demand.

structural_cues: The focus's أَنْ أَزِيدَ projects the speaker's act, while the close's إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ ٱللَّهُ makes divine willing the condition.
The repeated أَنْ-clause framing sharpens the reversal of whose volition governs the outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: human desire projects divine addition, while human remembering is later conditioned on divine will. Reader arrow: the close corrects the focus's implied control over the giver. Alternative: the closing will statement may govern remembrance only and need not retrospectively qualify the request for increase.

changed_reading.before: His desire reasonably forecasts the giver's next action.
changed_reading.after: His desire cannot program divine action; the surah closes by placing human response, not divine will, in the dependent position.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the stipend sense belongs to the noun أَطْمَاع while the focus uses a verb, and the later troops do not identify the desirer as a soldier. It remains anchored in the packet's ط م ع allotment branch and ج ن د cue; render it only as a patronage analogy, never as the lexical translation of يَطْمَعُ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins the stipend/allotment branch of ط م ع to an explicit request for further increase from a superior giver.

activation_trace.role: Soldiers' stipends supplies an expected allotment from authority as the unusual domain of desire.
Seeking and bidding for more turns the allotment into an escalating patronage claim.
A mutually supporting troop body activates the military-allotment domain elsewhere in the surah.

changed_reading.after: As a contained patronage analogy, he behaves like a retainer treating past allotment as grounds for a larger stipend.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading depends on the packet's non-dominant ز و د mapping and turns moral advance or delay into journey imagery, so it is branch-distant. It remains valid as an activation because أَزِيدَ is the focus anchor and 74:37 supplies explicit forward and delayed motion; qualify it as a provision metaphor, not morphology settled by context.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split-root provision branch for أَزِيدَ can make the hoped-for addition portable supply for movement.

activation_trace.role: Carrying provisions for transition supplies the portable rather than static sense of added stock.
Forward advance supplies one direction of the transition for which provision would be carried.
Delay to a later point supplies the opposed failure to move, making provision insufficient without chosen advance.

changed_reading.before: He asks for a larger static reserve.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, he asks to be provisioned for onward movement, while the later choice to advance or delay shows that supply cannot substitute for direction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The decoy bird, fleeing animals, and pursuer form a cross-species hunting analogy not asserted by the syntax, so the mechanism is deliberately strange. It remains anchored in the focus's explicit decoy branch and a later packet-backed flight-and-chase sequence; downstream prose should say 'as if' and avoid claiming that the requested increase literally is a trap.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ط م ع inventory names a decoy bird placed inside a net to draw others, allowing desired increase to function as bait.

activation_trace.role: A decoy bird in a net supplies baited attraction as the concealed structure of desire.
Further increase supplies the attractive bait toward which attention is drawn.
Recoiling and distancing supplies prey's first movement away from danger.
Flight and escape supplies the full evasive response within the capture system.
The pursuing qaswarah supplies the predator pressure that completes the bait, prey, and chase mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The desired increase is simply the reward at which he aims.
changed_reading.after: As a contained hunting analogy, 'more' is bait: fixation on it places the desirer inside a capture system whose danger becomes visible only when flight begins.

strongest_changes: Prior tailored extensions turn desire into a learned feedback loop that mistakes generosity for a promise of endless continuation.
The hoped-for upward increase is answered by an imposed upward ascent, preserving direction while reversing benefit into burden.
The repeated increase root in 74:31 relocates growth from passive receipt to the believers' increase in faith alongside certainty.
The parallel desire-and-delivery syntax in 74:52 extends the appetite for more into a demand for individually delivered disclosure.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly kept one feature of the focus construction while reversing another: upward direction survived with punitive valence, increase survived with changed agency and domain, and desire survived while its object shifted from addition to bespoke revelation. The split ز ي د mapping also preserved a contained journey-provision reading that a dominant-root-only trace would lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The immediate refusal may characterize the desire as entitlement, or it may only deny its requested outcome.
Later plural confessions can diagnose the same one-way acquisitive structure without necessarily describing the individual in 74:15.
The stipend, journey-provision, ledger, and decoy readings are branch-backed analogies whose form or domain distance prevents lexical certainty.
